description: Memory records and legacy aegis:Directive nodes changed since a cursor, for bobbin's memory mirror: current ones to upsert, superseded ones to delete; an owl:sameAs cluster is one item. cursor = '<instant>|<iri>' (a record's recordedAt or supersededAt; a legacy Directive's newest episode generatedAtTime, else the epoch), ordered by instant then iri; pass the last row's cursor back as since. 50 rows plus one overflow sentinel.
